title.narrative: Money Power: Enhancing grassroots women, youth, marginalised and indigenous people's voice and influence on public budget and fiscal policy at county level.

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to contribute to building strong, effective and transparent public institutions at county levels through enhanced responsive, inclusive and participatory decision making as envisioned in Kenya Constitution 2010 and Sustainable Development Goal 16.The specific objective of the project is to promote and strengthen public participation of grassroots women, youth, marginalized and indigenous people in Public Finance Management for effective service delivery and reduced social (gender, generation, income) inequalities in Muranga and Laikipia Counties.
